RenektonPreExecute.name: Ruthless Predator
RenektonPreExecute.tooltip:
Renekton's next Attack strikes twice, Stunning for @StunDuration@ seconds and dealing a total of @BasicTotalDamage@ physical damage. Hitting a champion generates an additional @BonusFuryVsChamps@ Fury.

Fury Bonus: Renekton Attacks 3 times instead, destroying Shields before dealing @EmpTotalDamage@ physical damage and Stunning for @EnragedStunDuration@ seconds. Does not generate any Fury.
All Attacks apply On-hit effects separately.
Does not break shields on monsters.

RenektonPredator.name: Reign of Anger
RenektonPredator.tooltip:
Renekton gains @FuryPerAttack@ Fury per Attack. While above @FuryCost@ Fury, his next Ability spends it to become empowered. Fury decays while out of combat.

While below @LowHealthPercentThreshold*100@% Health, Renekton gains @FuryIncreasePercent*100@% increased Fury.

RenektonSliceAndDice.name: Slice and Dice
RenektonSliceAndDice.tooltip:
Renekton dashes, dealing @BasicDamage@ physical damage. He generates @MinionRageGeneration@ Fury per non-champion and @ChampionRageGeneration@ Fury per champion hit. Hitting at least one enemy allows Renekton to Recast this Ability once for @DiceTimer@ seconds.

Fury Bonus: The Recast dash deals @EmpDamage@ physical damage instead and removes @EnragedArmorShred@% Armor for @ShredTimer@ seconds. Does not generate Fury.
Max @FuryMax@ Fury per cast.

RenektonCleave.name: Cull the Meek
RenektonCleave.tooltip:
Renekton swings his blade, dealing @BasicDamage@ physical damage and restoring @NonChampHealing@ Health per non-champion and @ChampHealing@ per champion hit. He also generates @MinionFuryGain@ Fury per non-champion and @ChampionFuryGain@ Fury per champion.

Fury Bonus: Damage is increased to @EmpDamage@ physical damage and healing is increased to @EmpNonChampHealing@ Health against non-champions and @EmpChampHealing@ Health against champions. Does not generate any Fury.
Max @FuryGainCap@ Fury per cast.
Restores up to @BasicHealCap@ Health on basic casts.
Restores up to @EmpoweredHealCap@ Health on empowered casts.
